description: This is a PHP source file for a page in the TestLink open source testing management system. It handles displaying and managing test event logs, including filtering, deleting, and presenting events in a table format with user permissions and localization features.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class representing an extended table for displaying event data, with capabilities for grouping, sorting, and toolbar controls.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request parameters and user info for the page.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to view or clear events.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure, including user lists, log levels, and filtering options.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Generates filtering criteria based on user input for date range and testers.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table to display the events, including sorting, grouping, and formatting.
